comments.author: ToppJeff
comments.body_html:
Good evening,

Forward from my question to Mighty_Condor:

“The new weapons look great, but the in game stats make them unusable. Additionally, the stats in the json files do not reflect in game. For example, the FDE ATL-15 has 29.9 ergo and 96.6 vertical recoil in game, but the json says 55 ergo, 135 v recoil… unless this is to refer to the lower receiver alone (they have the same in game name) but the lower in game is 28 and 221. So either way there is a discrepancy. Meanwhile, a stock M4 is 52 and 66. I feel like something isn’t translating, and because of that idk what to change in the json. any thoughts?

This is under realism, but the linked patch doesn’t correct the values either. It does add comfort and reload speed modifiers from realism to the rigs, so its doing something.“

I asked the Mighty_Condor and they don’t use realism so they weren’t sure. The values without realism translate over correctly. I expect that realism is changing the values, but idk why the values from the patch aren’t showing in game. Do you have an insight?

thanks in advance

comments.author: OptimusChad
comments.body_html: Sorry for the late response, not sure what the issue could be since it seems like the values are being changed for me, could be a load order issue? Make sure atlas is loading before realism otherwise realism changes the stats itself. If that’s not the issue then it might be a mod conflict of some sort.

comments.author: ToppJeff
comments.body_html: That was it, ty. I had it after
